timeline.reloading.meaning: Shows at the top of the Timeline while a pull, wheel or Refresh reloads Cadence and its connectors.

timeline.reloaded.meaning: Confirms that the Timeline reloaded Cadence and every connector.

previous.change: Outcome style: italic Ink at the same small size (Emi, product map answer 1).

timeline.reload-incomplete.meaning: Says a reload finished but Cadence or a connector did not refresh, so shown data may be old.
timeline.reload-incomplete.text: Reload incomplete. Cadence or connector data may be stale.

previous.change: Error style: one Rust Signal line at the same small size (Emi, product map answer 1).

timeline.reload-offline.meaning: Web: says a reload could not run while offline, so shown data may be old.
timeline.reload-offline.text: Reload failed while offline. Displayed data may be stale.

previous.change: Error style: one Rust Signal line at the same small size (Emi, product map answer 1).

timeline.left-to-decide.meaning: Counts the earlier items in Needs decision that still wait for Completed or Not Completed.
timeline.left-to-decide.text: {count, plural, =0 {None left to decide} other {# left to decide}}

reminder.opening.meaning: Mac: shows while Cadence opens the item a tapped reminder points to.

reminder.opened.meaning: Mac: confirms which item and day a tapped reminder opened.

previous.change: Outcome style: italic Ink (Emi, product map answer 1).

reminder.open-failed.meaning: Mac: says a tapped reminder could not open its item, with the reason.

previous.change: Error style: one Rust Signal line (Emi, product map answer 1).

reminder.unavailable.meaning: Mac: says the item a tapped reminder points to is no longer in this Mac's local data.
reminder.unavailable.text: That reminder’s occurrence is no longer available in this local profile.

previous.change: Error style: one Rust Signal line (Emi, product map answer 1).

timeline.duration-choose-behavior.meaning: Says the inline default-duration form was submitted without a Behavior.

timeline.duration-invalid-minutes.meaning: Says the inline intended-duration input needs a whole number of minutes from 1 to 1,440.
timeline.duration-invalid-minutes.text: Enter a whole number from 1 to 1,440 minutes.

timeline.duration-unavailable.meaning: Says the Behavior whose intended duration is being set is no longer available.
timeline.duration-unavailable.text: This Behavior is no longer available.

timeline.duration-revision-changed.meaning: Says the Behavior changed elsewhere while saving its intended duration.
timeline.duration-revision-changed.text: This Behavior was just updated. Try saving again.

timeline.duration-save-failed.meaning: Says saving the Behavior's intended duration failed.

timeline.duration-saved.meaning: Confirms the Behavior's intended duration was saved from the Timeline row.

previous.change: The field is now the intended duration; tracked time decides the length from 3 tracked completions (Ticket 366, D34).

timeline.note-saving.meaning: Shows beside the note editor while a day note, an occurrence note or the note of an existing Period is saving.

timeline.note-saved.meaning: Confirms that a day note, an occurrence note or the note of an existing Period has saved, inline in the editor and, for day and occurrence notes, briefly beside the collapsed one-line summary.
